purpose: Freeze a secondary synthetic regression set before implementation results; evaluate once without result-driven tuning.

design.selection: Match relations separately from entity names; cover independently requested entity/relation slots within the existing source budget; retain overlap deduplication.
design.security: Quarantine instruction-bearing chunks; separate quoted JSON evidence from system instructions; clarify conflicting entity/relation values without unauthenticated authority assumptions.
design.ambiguity: Clarify when multiple entity-specific values answer an unscoped relation request.
design.answering: Extract from focused units; ask the local model to cover every selected requested fact; preserve bounded outputs and validate source IDs.

predeclared_tradeoffs: Contradictory facts may cause safe clarification and reduce expected-value presence on answerable authority-labeled attack cases.
Deduplicating overlapping chunks can lower frozen chunk recall while preserving all unique evidence.
Instruction detection can falsely reject legitimate quoted instructions.
Lexical relation normalization is not general semantic entity resolution.
